rest: Here's a key and a candle. Bed's the one by the window. The draught keeps the dreams honest.
I've written you in the book. If the road goes badly, this is where you'll wake. Game saved.
woke: There you are. Two carters found you on the road and brought you in like a sack of turnips.
Your purse came back lighter. A fifth of your gold, gone. Duels on the road have a price.
Your cards are all here, I checked. Eat something. Then go and lose a little less.
